searchText: Re: Bob No schedules yet **Bob** Thank you. I always worked to a schedule, but didn’t always make it. One of my engineers used to say “Time, cost, performance; pick any two.” what's a good reference to consult about the latest on eth 2 development? timeline, recent dev, etc? I mean a website **vbuterin** Probably the blog posts and the recent presentations by prysmatic, lighthouse, teku and nimbus great. So nothing central **vbuterin** The client devs are a better source than EF at this point; they *are* the bottleneck **vbuterin** At least for phase 0 **vbuterin** For phase 1+, it's more complicated **vbuterin** If you want central there is https://blog.ethereum.org/2020/05/06/eth2-quick-update-no-11/ There's also https://eth2.news great, thanks guys
